name: STYLE-005 英雄卡通厚涂卡面风
prefix:
[D4-MEDIUM] Hand-painted 2D digital illustration in a polished fantasy game card-art style: the main character is smoothly blended with almost invisible brushwork, visible dry-brush texture and scratchy strokes are confined to the background and secondary props, all highlights painted as crisp loose painterly strokes rather than rendered reflections; hair has matte painted strand clumps with only a few soft satin sheen strokes, no glossy plastic shine; glass, gems and metal stay graphic and simplified, gems read as stylized flat-cut facets with broad simple shapes of light, surface wear suggested with a few broad strokes only, no realistic chips, no photoreal refraction, no specular CG rendering anywhere; NOT a 3D render, NOT a photograph, no airbrushed vector smoothness.
[D1-FORM] Exaggerated cartoon expressiveness on believable semi-real anatomy: whatever the head-to-body ratio, every figure reads as bold stylized card art; the face is built from big simple readable shapes with strong forms, a clearly sculpted bold nose, full simplified lips, broad expressive brows, large clean eye shapes, cheeks and jaw as broad soft volumes, never delicate miniature features, the face reads as a bold cartoon even when beautiful; hands noticeably oversized relative to the body, fingers simplified into clear graphic shapes; muscles, fat, chest and belly as inflated soft geometric volumes like spheres, sacks and cylinders, never realistic muscle anatomy; cloth folds simplified into broad sweeping shapes; hair and beards as large flowing graphic clumps; teeth as simple rounded blocks; strong clear silhouette with dynamic readable poses; the underlying anatomy stays believable so the face never collapses into flat comic caricature; no drawn outline anywhere, form edges carried only by color-mass contrast and value steps.
[D2-SHADING] Painterly gradient shading with real volume: soft matte gradients blending light into shadow across each form, mostly soft-edged terminators with a few crisp tapered crease strokes; a single warm dominant key light lighting the whole scene uniformly, plus at most a faint cool rim that only barely kisses one edge of the silhouette without tinting any half of the face or scene orange or blue; deep rich shadows that never crush to black, broad soft satin sheen highlights on skin, small crisp painted glints on gems and metal, gentle contact shadows.
[D3-PALETTE] High-saturation jewel-tone colors for the character and its treasures against a muted, softly hazy background; complementary warm-light versus cool-shadow color tension across the whole frame.
[D5-SPACE] Eye-level framing with mild perspective, background softly defocused by loose painterly haze rather than optical blur, centered subject.
[CONTENT]
suffix: [NEGATIVE] no cel shading, no photoreal macro skin texture, no split orange-blue lighting, no glossy plastic hair highlights, no photoreal gem refraction, no photoreal beauty portrait face, no delicate miniature features.
